trial_court: Additional Sessions Judge (Ad hoc), Faridabad, FIR No. 74 dated 5.3.2006 under Sections 363,366, 376, 120-B, 506 IPC
case_name: Beena Bisth vs Vinod Singla And Others
facts_of_case: Unmarried girl aged about 18 years was kidnapped and forcibly taken to the house of accused where she was offered intoxicants and became unconscious. She woke up in a naked condition.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the complainant to explain the delay in lodging the FIR.
legal_principles.held: Learned trial court after going through the evidence on record held that there was unexplained delay of four months in lodging the FIR and the same was fatal to the case.
cited_cases: Beena Bisth vs Vinod Singla And Others, (2009)

legal_principles.principle: The law requires a complainant to explain the delay in lodging the FIR.
cited_cases: Beena Bisth vs Vinod Singla And Others, (2009)

outcome.final_order: The trial court's decision acquitting the respondents is set aside, and the case is remanded to the trial court for fresh consideration.

use_for_drafting: drafting a revision petition against acquittal
arguing a case of murder and criminal charges
seeking justice for an unmarried girl
